info.title: MICrONS functional window
info.description: 15-minute window of MICrONS two-photon functional imaging (DANDI 000402, sub-17797 ses-4 scan-9): stimulus movie downsampled to 36x64 grayscale and aligned to the 6.3 Hz imaging rate, plus z-scored fluorescence traces for all segmented neurons. Derived from the public MICrONS release.
